reviews.concise_rationale: The crop is readable but it only shows a generic pre-training architecture for DNA/protein/natural language, not the summary-generation or title-generation input route for gene_eng_gpt2_summary. A different paper figure is needed.

The crop shows a coherent single-cell transcriptomics input path, but the visible model label is scLLM rather than the exact named model scGPT. Another figure or crop with the correct model variant is needed.

The crop clearly shows H&E as the input to the MUPAD virtual staining setup, with the corresponding IHC target and competing methods. It is coherent, readable, and supports the H&E-to-IHC translation route.
